data.fund_name: WhiteOak Capital Large & Mid Cap Fund
data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing in both large cap and mid cap stocks.
data.investment_objective: The primary objective of the scheme is to generate long term capital appreciation by investing in and managing a diversified portfolio of equity and equity related instruments of large and mid cap companies. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
